GenAiFunction.description: When customer asks to help them to complete subscription or buy now or purchase now, agent will initiate this action to call the Create_Opportunity auto-launched flow and create a new opportunity and opportunity products. If the flow fails or if it return Error Messages, agent will politely inform the customer that we couldn't complete the order, one of our agents will reach out to soon. If the payment link is returned from the flow, then we need to ask customer to complete the payment by clicking the payment link. After payment is completed, he will receive a slack invitation link to his email and further details will be provided on slack.
